title: Report process environment
responsibility: Combines report settings with explicit environment overrides for report configuration and Cloudflare context.

outputs.name: reportsEnvironment
outputs.description: Copied process environment with PROJECT_REPORTS_CONFIG_FILE and PROJECT_REPORTS_CLOUDFLARE_CONFIG_HOME filled from settings only when not already set. Reads HARNESS_REPORTS_SETTINGS_FILE or the default user report-settings.json; missing file is allowed.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown with Invalid Harness report settings file for a non-ENOENT read failure or JSON parse failure.
